original_ai_output.title_zh: 刚果（金）抗议F1在卢旺达举办赛事，称其决定“站不住脚”
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 刚果（金）外交部长泰蕾兹·卡伊克万巴·瓦格纳批评一级方程式（F1）计划在卢旺达举办非洲大奖赛，称此举将“美化一位威权领导人的形象”。卢旺达总统卡加梅与F1及国际汽联负责人于周二宣布该赛事，计划于2030年代初在基加利附近布格塞拉尚未建成的赛道举行。刚果（金）、美国及联合国专家指控卢旺达支持刚果（金）东部M23武装，卢旺达称其安全措施旨在防范跨境武装组织威胁。

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）外交部长批评F1计划在卢旺达举办非洲大奖赛
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Formula One will “polish the image of an authoritarian leader” if it goes ahead with plans to hold an African Grand Prix in Rwanda, the foreign minister of neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo, Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner, said Thursday.

key_facts.fact: 卢旺达总统卡加梅与F1及国际汽联负责人周二宣布该赛事
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Rwandan President Paul Kagame joined F1 Chief Executive Stefano Domenicali and FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem on Tuesday to announce the race.

key_facts.fact: 赛事计划于2030年代初在基加利附近布格塞拉尚未建成的赛道举行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: It will be held at a circuit yet to be built at Bugesera, near Rwanda’s capital Kigali, in “the early 2030s," F1 says.

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）、美国及联合国专家指控卢旺达支持刚果（金）东部M23武装
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The DRC, the United States and United Nations experts accuse Rwanda of backing M23 rebels in eastern DRC.

key_facts.fact: 卢旺达称其安全措施旨在防范跨境武装组织威胁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Rwanda says its security measures are intended to protect it against threats from armed groups operating across the border.

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
卢旺达支持M23武装的指控来自刚果（金）、美国及联合国专家，卢旺达予以否认，相关说法存在冲突
